A branch of 31 families runs through columns 4 to 34, a parallel path carried in 11 to 12%.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 100% against 94%, and hesitates less there, 0.08 against 0.28 bits. Its most hesitant column, 7, `thrS`, is a fork column, at 1.19 bits.

**The window ends at column 79, `ydhL`**, a fork column carried by 72%, with `ydhF` at 46% and `sodC` at 23%.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.28 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.74 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 61% against 97%.

label: hxpB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the hxpB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hxpB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,012 to 2,091 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hxpB once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,994 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; shell 4,594 calls, named 69%, 1.11 bits; cloud 292 calls, named 14%, 4.34 bits. Outside an RGP 40,172 calls, named 97%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 2,708 calls, named 61%, 1.74 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 63 fork, 16 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.74 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (61% against 97%); 2,708 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 7 (thrS, a fork column) 1.19 bits, RGP 2%; column 30 (ydiP, a fork column) 0.63 bits, RGP 7%; column 25 (fadK, a fork column) 0.58 bits, RGP 6%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 100%, 0.08 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 94%, 0.28 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 7, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: hxpB. named 100%; 0.08 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 10-88%, 74 P, 5 S, RGP 0-16%. named 64-99.6% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 64%, 1.19 bits.
